integrity: The affine first integral, transformed leaf equations, no-equilibrium condition, invariant-measure balance, and published-parameter initial-condition leaf value were reconstructed directly from the printed vector field. The Lyapunov conclusion is proved from an invariant tangent subbundle, identity quotient cocycle, and the nonvanishing flow direction; no finite-time numerical spectrum is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The no-hyperchaos conclusion is conditional on negative Lyapunov sum; arbitrary non-dissipative invariant measures are not excluded from having two positive exponents.
The result does not classify the reduced three-dimensional leaf dynamics or establish existence of a particular chaotic invariant set.
The literature search cannot exclude an unindexed or inaccessible prior correction of the same affine first integral.
title: Affine first integral forces a two-neutral Lyapunov spectrum in a memristive Sprott-A flow
